entries.title: Act as you from your terminal
entries.body: The Infinitary command now acts as you, not only reads. Run infinitary-axi say to send your first mate your words, card act to press a card's button, card reply or card close, and task steer, stop, start or queue to move a task. Each change shows on its task as yours, from infinitary-axi.
entries.noPicture: What changed is what the terminal command can do; the one line it changes in Settings shows in the Infinitary command note's picture.
